How every service works

AI drafts, a person on our team checks, and you approve. Nothing goes out in your name until you have approved it. Taxes, payroll, legal work and moving money stay with you and your licensed pros. We prep, draft and remind. You approve.

  • AI drafts, we check, you approveAI makes a first draft, a person on our team checks it, and you approve it. 21 services.
  • We do itA person on our team does the work. Most of these need no AI at all. 17 services.

Every example below describes a made-up Northwest Arkansas business, written to show how the service works. They are not clients, and they are not results.
